captured_cases.expected_outcome: The incomplete calendar traces to exact upstream words requiring a twelve-month annual roadmap.
The corrected calendar traces to exact upstream words defining a twelve-month content calendar.

atomic_step.outcome: A criticism that belongs upstream carries an immutable source identity and an exact quotation from that registered producer source.
atomic_step.practical_value: The operator can repair the promise or input that caused a weak page instead of polishing only the visible symptom.
atomic_step.stopping_condition: The unchanged incomplete and corrected calendar cases both bind exact upstream source words, invented source quotes refuse, and an upstream-trace defect cannot complete without that evidence.

final_validation.failure_criterion: Either source identity is lost or invented source words are accepted.
final_validation.operator_path: Open each unchanged page, register its exact producer packet, attach a trace, then record both readers.
final_validation.success_criterion: The incomplete and corrected calendars both preserve their exact producer evidence.

approaches.hypothesis: A page quotation alone is enough to localize an upstream defect.
approaches.implementation: Store only words from the criticized page.
approaches.predicted_tradeoff: Simple, but cannot prove which producer promise was lost.

approaches.hypothesis: A frozen source plus an exact quotation makes the upstream cause inspectable.
approaches.implementation: Register the source value, retain its identity and hash, and accept only exact quotations.
approaches.predicted_tradeoff: One explicit registration step in exchange for causal evidence.

mini_probes.goal: Bind upstream criticism to immutable producer identity and exact source words.
mini_probes.practical_value: The operator can repair the promise or input that caused a weak page instead of polishing only the visible symptom.

proof.failure_criterion: A defect can complete without producer evidence or a non-source quotation is accepted.
proof.success_criterion: Both cases retain source identity, exact producer words, and reject an invented quotation.

winner_output.description: Immutable source registration, exact trace validation, and a defect gate.

mini_probes.work_type_reason: Code freezes sources, validates quotations, and blocks unsupported upstream defects.
